messages:
Olivia - Alliances: Quick alignment thread for Stratus co-sell on HorizonGrid. Need a simple, auditable handoff flow + credit rules before Tuesday demo.
Maya - Sales: Agree. Main pain: portal intros vs AE outreach — we keep getting duplicates.
Kai (Stratus SI): From Stratus: introduced = 32% Y1; joint = 12%; if Stratus runs and funds POC = 42%. Happy to be flexible on timelines.
Ravi - GTM Ops: Proposal: portal intro timestamp wins if earlier than AE.first_contact. If AE contacted first, route to co-sell-review. AE tag: #si-handoff triggers PartnerBot.
Noah - Finance: Add opp fields: si_partner_id, si_role (introduced|joint|poc_lead), si_credit_pct, si_credit_locked_at (ts). Lock at contract signature.
Olivia - Alliances: Claim windows: AE must log outreach within 5 business days of portal intro, else SI claim stands. SI must ack intake within 48h.
Maya - Sales: CRM mapping pseudo-rule: if account.exists and owner != si.owner -> create subop(type='si_collab', parent=acct.id, tag='si:Stratus') else assign owner = si.owner. Subop uses estimate_acv; parent retains canonical ACV.
PartnerBot: auto: created partner-intake ticket PT-99102 for HorizonGrid / Stratus. Captured portal_ts=1847651200.
Kai (Stratus SI): We'll ack PT-99102 within 24h and upload POC scope + shipping proof if applicable.
Noah - Finance: For marketplace co-marketing: if SI funds POC, apply one-time marketing credit (5% of POC invoice). Need si_po_number on opp.
Ravi - GTM Ops: Final action items: 1) Platform: implement subop flow + expose timestamps to PartnerBot webhook. 2) Finance: add opp fields above. 3) Marketing: prepare 1-pager template (2bd after ack). 4) Olivia: update SI playbook and circulate.
Olivia - Alliances: Thanks all 91d: capturing and will post PRD link here once done.
